t: The Briticent 22m LED festoon light chain provides high-output illumination for various work environments. This robust lighting solution is ideal for construction site walkways, workshops, and temporary outdoor setups, ensuring clear visibility. It features 10 x E27 6500K daylight LED lamps, delivering a powerful 10,000 lumens across a 22m length with 2m spacing. Designed for durability, it offers an IP44 rating for indoor and outdoor use, drop impact-resistance, and replaceable polycarbonate lamps to minimise on-site hazards. The 110V mains powered system requires a transformer and offers up to 30,000 hours of life.
